pages.title: Hot stones
text: **Sweat Stones** steam and glow when they sit over heat: a lit campfire, fire, magma, lava or an Ember Bowl underneath. Take the heat away and they go cold.
Put some in a small hut with a bed and you have a sweat lodge.

pages.title: A night in the lodge
text: Sleep the whole night through in a bed with **hot Sweat Stones within 5 blocks** and **a roof over you** (anything solid a few blocks above the bed).
You wake **fully healed**, with every harmful effect gone, **10 minutes** of [Spirit Blessing](spirit_sickness) and a little Regeneration. It only works if you actually sleep until morning.
